content: For individuals with triglyceride levels ranging from 175 to 499 mg/dL (2.0–5.6 mmol/L), healthcare providers should focus on identifying and addressing lifestyle factors that may be contributing to the elevated triglyceride levels. These factors include obesity and the presence of metabolic syndrome. In patients who have atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease (ASCVD) or other cardiovascular risk factors, the addition of icosapent ethyl as an adjunctive therapy may be considered to help reduce the risk of cardiovascular events.
